display.purpose: Exact product name and concentrated identity only.

headline.purpose: Maç Defteri, Sıralama, and route hierarchy.

label.purpose: Route state and short supporting labels.

shadows.name: rail-separation
shadows.purpose: Separates the pinned rail from moving week columns.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Collapses transitions and scrolling motion when requested.

components.name: Action Seal
components.description: The single lower-corner 53 control that reveals route actions.
components.css: .ds-action-seal { width: 58px; height: 58px; display: grid; place-items: center; padding: 0; border: 2px solid #c79a45; border-radius: 50%; background: #151c26; color: #ebca7c; box-shadow: 0 8px 22px rgb(0 0 0 / 34%); font: 800 1.3rem/1 Alegreya, Georgia, serif; } .ds-action-seal:hover { background: #2c3746; } .ds-action-seal:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #2a82c7; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Rivalry Score
components.description: Named blue-versus-orange team totals with the total match count centered.
components.css: .ds-score { min-height: 88px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0,1fr) 72px minmax(0,1fr); color: #fff; font-family: 'Alegreya Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-score > div { display: grid; place-content: center; justify-items: center; } .ds-score-blue { background: #244d86; } .ds-score-orange { background: #8f3e17; } .ds-score-center { background: #151c26; color: #ebca7c; border-inline: 1px solid #c79a45; } .ds-score span { font-weight: 700; } .ds-score strong { font: 700 2.55rem/.9 Alegreya, Georgia, serif; } .ds-score-center strong { font-size: 1.9rem; color: #fff; }

components.name: Weekly Matrix Player
components.description: The canonical crest, player, and civilization hierarchy inside a 64px team row.
components.css: .ds-player { min-height: 64px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 46px minmax(0,1fr); align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 7px 11px; border-bottom: 1px solid #c7ad82; background: #dce8f6; color: #26180f; font-family: 'Alegreya Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-player img { width: 42px; height: 42px; object-fit: contain; } .ds-player strong, .ds-player small { display: block; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-player strong { font-size: 1.05rem; line-height: 1.05; } .ds-player small { margin-top: 3px; color: #725d48; font-size: .78rem; }

components.name: Inline Matrix Selects
components.description: Two native controls replace public copy without changing the player row geometry.
components.css: .ds-edit-player { min-height: 64px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 42px minmax(0,1fr); grid-template-rows: 1fr 1fr; align-items: center; gap: 2px 9px; padding: 4px 11px; background: #dce8f6; } .ds-edit-player img { grid-row: 1 / 3; width: 42px; height: 42px; } .ds-edit-player select { width: 100%; min-width: 0; min-height: 28px; border: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid #86673b; border-radius: 0; background: transparent; color: #26180f; font: 400 .82rem/1.2 'Alegreya Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-edit-player select:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #2a82c7; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Standings Table
components.description: Fixed rank/player/O/G/M/% columns that remain complete on a 390px phone.
components.css: .ds-stats { width: 360px; table-layout: fixed; border-collapse: collapse; background: #faedcf; color: #26180f; font: 400 17px/1.35 'Alegreya Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-stats th, .ds-stats td { height: 44px; padding: 8px 5px; border-bottom: 1px solid #c7ad82; text-align: center; } .ds-stats thead th { background: #202936; color: #fff; font-size: .78rem; } .ds-stats tbody th { text-align: left; }

narrative.overview: One continuous, hand-kept competitive record translated into a fast phone interface: compact command band, named rivalry score, and a parchment matrix that carries every real match exactly once.
keyCharacteristics: Newest match at the left edge of one horizontally scrolling matrix.
Square flat data geometry structured by bronze rules.
Full-field named team colors and real local civilization crests.
One 53 action seal and one explicit publish action in the editor.

rules.name: Named Rivalry
rules.body: Team color is always paired with the exact team name or winner word.

rules.name: Continuous Matrix
rules.body: Every match appears once; older weeks continue to the right.

rules.name: Flat Until Elevated
rules.body: Only seals, menus, notices, dialogs, and the desktop document edge lift.

rules.name: Seal Exception
rules.body: Circular geometry belongs only to the 53 identity and concentrated action.

dos: Do preserve the 108px sticky rail and 260px week columns on phones.
Do keep player name and civilization visible in every public cell.
Do use same-origin open editing with explicit publish and conflict feedback.
Do verify 320px, 390px, and 1440px without document overflow.
donts: Don't split matches into latest, recent, and archive surfaces.
Don't switch the matrix to cards on narrow screens.
Don't add persistent sidebar, header bar, footer, or bottom navigation.
Don't add PINs, user tokens, gradients, glass, or decorative medieval frames.
